column1: satAssistanceInfoListSatellite assistance information used to detect and perform measurements on the indicated frequency. If the field is not present, the UE uses the ntn-Config field(s) of elements in ntn-NeighCellConfigList or ntn-NeighCellConfigListExt in SIB19 for which the carrierFreq matches.

ssbSubcarrierSpacingSubcarrier spacing of SSB in the redirected SSB frequency.Only the following values are applicable depending on the used frequency:FR1/FR1-NTN:    15 or 30 kHzFR2-1/FR2-NTN:  120 or 240 kHzFR2-2:  120, 480, or 960 kHz

smtcThe SSB periodicity/offset/duration configuration for the redirected SSB frequency. It is based on timing reference of PCell. If the field is absent, the UE uses the SMTC configured in the measObjectNR having the same SSB frequency and subcarrier spacing. If smtc-r19 is configured, the offset (derived from parameter periodicityAndOffset) is based on the assumption that the propagation delay difference between UE-serving cell at gNB and UE-neighbour cell at gNB equals to 0 ms, and UE can adjust the offset based on the actual propagation delay difference.
